headline: Nearly 7 lakh fail as SSC pass rate hits 19-year low
summary: The pass rate has dropped to 62.25%, with girls continuing to outperform boys for the 11th consecutive year.
details: The results for the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) and equivalent examinations have been published, revealing a significant decline in performance.
The overall pass rate has plummeted to 62.25%, marking the lowest pass rate in the last 19 years.
Nearly 7 lakh students failed to pass the examinations, highlighting a concerning trend in national academic achievement.
For the 11th consecutive year, girls have outperformed boys in the overall results, maintaining a consistent lead in academic success.
Educationists have expressed concern, attributing the low pass rate to systemic failures within the education system.
The results have sparked a debate on the need for urgent reforms to improve the quality of education and student performance across the country.

headline: 16 Bangladeshis killed in Saudi factory fire
summary: A devastating blaze at a sofa factory in Riyadh has claimed the lives of 16 Bangladeshi nationals, with only one survivor from a room of 17 people.
details: A catastrophic fire broke out at a sofa manufacturing factory in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, resulting in the deaths of 16 Bangladeshi migrant workers.
Reports indicate that 17 workers were inside a single room at the time of the blaze, and only one person managed to survive the tragedy.
Among the victims, three men from the same area in Natore district were killed, leaving three families devastated.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has expressed her deep mourning over the loss of the 16 Bangladeshi nationals in the incident.
The tragedy highlights the precarious living and working conditions often faced by migrant workers abroad.

The tragedy highlights the precarious living and working conditions often faced by migrant workers abroad.
